rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides an educational demonstration of how a fake compliance checker might work in theory. Includes a guideline-check tool that transparently always returns positive results regardless of input, serving as a teaching example for understanding potential security considerations in LLM systems. The implementation is intentionally non-functional and openly declares its demonstrative purpose.
